You will work on backend services and data modeling, where reliability, scalability, and data integrity are foundational requirements.

You should understand where AI assistance is genuinely useful in core Java development, and where human precision is irreplaceable.

* Define, develop, and maintain software modules and features with a focus on reliability, scalability, and data integrity.
* As part of an AI-enabled SDLC, leverage AI coding assistants for development, code reviews, and test case generation, while ensuring the quality and safety of AI-generated output.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to translate product requirements into implementations
* Resolve technical issues through debugging, research, and investigation — creating new and innovative ways to improve platform applications.

* Collaborate effectively with a geographically distributed team.

AI Skills

* Critical review of AI-generated code: logic errors, security risks, edge cases, style

* CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, OOD, design patterns — applied to applications in production
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis across distributed codebases
* Good knowledge of DevOps and Cloud technologies; ability to write basic SQL queries.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot applications and environment issues.

JAVA Skills
  
  

* Strong core Java proficiency — Java 11 or later; solid understanding of the Java memory model, garbage collection, and JVM behavior.
* Experience with Java/J2EE, JMS, Message Broker, and Java stack technologies in a professional product or enterprise context.
* Strong system thinking skills to design and build scalable, reliable, and maintainable Java-based backend systems
* Good knowledge of Client-Server architectures and RESTful API design.

Collaboration & Soft Skills
  
  

* Good team spirit and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent written, Verbal, Communication skills, Analytical skills & Business thinking.

**Qualifications**

* B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Sciences, or a related discipline from a reputed institution with a good academic track record.

* Work at the intersection of deep PLM domain expertise and AI-augmented engineering; a rare combination that will define the highest-value development of the decade.

Join a team developing forwarding software for Cisco IOS XR service provider platforms. You’ll work on software that moves packets through high-capacity routers, contributing to Layer 2 and Layer 3 features across the forwarding path.
  
This role suits an engineer with solid networking fundamentals, hands-on C or C++ experience, and an interest in embedded systems. You’ll work with experienced engineers to implement features, investigate defects, and improve code and test coverage. Regular use of approved AI tools is part of the engineering workflow; engineers remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-generated output.

As a Software Support Case Coordinator, you play a key role in delivering an efficient, accurate, and customer-focused Software Support experience.

You serve as one of the primary entry points into the Software Support organization, coordinating incoming customer requests from initial contact through case creation, validation, prioritization, dispatching, and operational follow-up.

You work closely with Technical Leads, Senior Engineers, Software Support Engineers, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to ensure customer requests are accurately processed and reach the appropriate resources within defined service targets.

The role combines the responsibilities of Case Validation and Configuration Validation, creating broader ownership of front-line Software Support coordination and enabling consistent operational coverage across the team.

==============================

-----------------------------------------------

* Answer incoming customer support calls during the assigned shift.
* Understand the customer's request and collect relevant technical and operational information.
* Create support cases with complete and accurate information.
* Select the correct Account, Asset, and Product.
* Assess the urgency of the customer's request.
* Based on the urgency, route the case to the appropriate Software Support Engineer.
* Ensure urgent customer situations are brought to the attention of the appropriate technical resources without unnecessary delay.
* Provide customers with a professional, consistent, and efficient support experience.

**2. Case Validation and On-Time Delivery**
-------------------------------------------

Ensure that all applicable new and existing cases are validated accurately and within the defined timeframe during the assigned shift.

### **a. On-Time Delivery**

* Validate all applicable new and existing cases during the assigned shift within 15 minutes.
* Ensure that cases contain sufficient and accurate information before they are dispatched.
* If unavailable, proactively coordinate with another Software Support Case Coordinator and obtain agreement to ensure continuous validation coverage.
* Take responsibility for ensuring that cases are either validated personally or appropriately covered by another team member.

### **b. First Time Right: Account / Asset / Product**

* Ensure that the correct Account, Asset, and Product are selected for each case.
* Work closely with the relevant Technical Leads, Senior Engineers, and Software Support Engineers when validation information is unclear.
* Apply knowledge gained from previous cases to continuously improve validation accuracy.
* Continuously develop product and process knowledge to improve First Time Right performance and progressively reduce dependency on others.

### **c. Prioritization**

* Evaluate each case based on the customer's situation and actual business impact.

* For Critical and Down cases, actively coordinate with the Software Support team to ensure that the case is picked up and actioned promptly.
